ArtifactRefV1.description:
A reference to a stored artifact — never the raw bytes themselves.

Stages pass around pointers (path + hash + mime type). The actual file
lives in the object store (S3-compatible); the manifest / envelope only
ever stores the reference.

path.description: Content-addressed storage path/key for the artifact, e.g. 's3://bucket/artifacts/<sha256>.mp4'. Must not be a mutable alias such as 'latest.mp4'.
path.title: Path

hash.description: SHA-256 hex digest of the artifact contents.
hash.title: Hash

mime_type.description: MIME type of the stored artifact, e.g. 'video/mp4', 'audio/wav', 'application/json'.
mime_type.title: Mime Type

created_at.description: UTC timestamp when this artifact reference was created.
created_at.title: Created At

ArtifactRefV1.title: ArtifactRefV1

description: Records why a stage's output failed validation.

failure_type.description: Machine-readable failure category, e.g. 'hash_mismatch'. This is the failure_code the M3 roadmap refers to - kept as failure_type since that name is already threaded through ValidationReportV1, RETRYABLE_VALIDATION_FAILURE_TYPES, and every stage validator; renaming it would be a larger, purely cosmetic change touching every validator for no behavioral gain.
failure_type.title: Failure Type

feedback_context.description: Context to carry into a retried attempt of this stage, e.g. what specifically went wrong, so the provider can correct for it on the next attempt.
feedback_context.title: Feedback Context

failed_at.description: UTC timestamp when this validation failure was recorded.
failed_at.title: Failed At

failed_field.description: Which specific field/check failed, e.g. 'scenes[1]' or 'duration'. None when the failure isn't localized to one field (e.g. a corrupt/unreadable file).
failed_field.title: Failed Field

evidence_ref.description: Pointer to the stored ValidationReportV1 (or offending artifact) backing this failure - makes the failure inspectable later instead of living only in a log line.

retryable.description: Whether this failure_type is in RETRYABLE_VALIDATION_FAILURE_TYPES at the time this record was raised. Duplicated onto the record itself (rather than only computed later in pipeline.py) so a failure is self-describing without cross-referencing pipeline.py's set.
retryable.title: Retryable

suggested_fix.description: Short, validator-authored hint for a human reading a failed run later. Distinct from feedback_context, which is prose meant to go back into a retried LLM prompt, not for a person.
suggested_fix.title: Suggested Fix
